title: Visual Direction
description: One complete evaluated design direction for one Evaluation Case. Approval here is a curation-scope decision only: it does NOT imply layout readiness, font registration, or production-D1 mutation -- those remain separate milestones owned by channel-content-os's own production-readiness gates.

layoutVersionId.description: Set only once a real, registered layout version exists. Absent for a purely exploratory direction.

provenance.description: Real source/reference used (a real repo file or module), what structural/compositional idea was borrowed, and what was discarded -- never 'the repo chose this'.

productionApproved.description: Always false at this stage -- approving a Visual Direction never registers a font in channel-content-os's production fonts table.

kind.description: REPO_FILE only when `path` is a real, existing repo-relative file. EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_HISTORY when the render was delivered for human review but never copied into canonical repo storage -- never invent a path to make this look canonically stored.

path.description: Real repo-relative path. Required when kind=REPO_FILE, must be omitted otherwise.

decisionNote.description: Why approved/rejected, and under what conditions this direction should/should not be used.
